headlines.description: Manchester United fell to one of the most embarrassing European defeats in their history as Champions League upstarts Como ran out 4-1 victors on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Como embarrass Man United as rout adds to Carrick pressure

headlines.description: Aston Villa maintained their 100% start to the Champions League campaign after they earned a comfortable 3-1 victory over Norwegian side Viking at Villa Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Villa beat Viking to continue UCL winning start

headlines.description: Declan Rice stole the limelight from Harry Kane as Arsenal hit back to snatch a thrilling 2-2 draw against Bayern Munich in a heavyweight clash Wednesday at the Allianz Arena.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bayern Munich snap Arsenal win streak in thrilling 2-2 draw

headlines.description: Real Madrid maintained their perfect start in the Champions League with an emphatic 4-1 victory over RB Leipzig on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Diomande stunner caps Madrid win against former club Leipzig
